choices.content: Each positive number corresponds to its two square roots
Each \(x\) may correspond to any number no less than itself

question.prompt: Which of the following correspondences is a function from the set of real numbers to the set of real numbers?

solutions.explanation: A function requires each \(x\) to correspond to exactly one \(y\). Two square roots, \(y^2=x\), and “any one” all fail to give a unique value.
solutions.title: Use the function definition
